_comment: THE FAMILY FOLD (#1825). Two stats windows beside pr-payloads.json and friction-keys.json, driven by assertAcceptance directly (statsFindings is pure over injected inputs) because their pins are shape assertions on one window each, not counts over the whole class. Every verdict comment carries the full 40-hex head the wave grammar requires and names its own pull request's number padded to 40 hex, so no rework row (head-moved, repair) is in play -- the class words are what these windows are about, and they are words VERDICT_CLASSES never taught, which is exactly why the histogram keys them raw as their own rows.
_acceptance_comment: The acceptance window reproduces the measured since-v6.7.14 hole in miniature: mutation 2, mutation-vacuous 1, mutation-survivor 1 -- every exact id below the threshold of 3 -- while the family the four pull requests compose sits at 4 distinct pull requests, over it. The histogram that keys exact ids only prints quiet here; the family fold must print exactly one `mutation (family)` would-open line at 4, and no exact-id line.
_controls_comment: The controls window carries the three null controls in one window. (1) NO DOUBLE-COUNT: 9305 carries both a mutation and a mutation-vacuous verdict, so the naive fold reads 4 over three pull requests -- the family must fire on the UNION, exactly one line, at 3; and mutation's own exact id is at 3 here (over threshold), so the window also pins that the id line and the family line each fire once, not one per member. (2) QUIET STAYS QUIET: environment (9308) + seat-environment (9309) compose a family at 2 distinct pull requests, below threshold, which must print no family line.
